Title: Verify valid user can login successfully
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps: 1. Enter valid username in Username field\n2. Enter valid password in Password field\n3. Click Login button
Expected Result: User is redirected to inventory page with product catalog displayed

Title: Verify locked out user receives error message
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps: 1. Enter 'locked_out_user' in Username field\n2. Enter valid password in Password field\n3. Click Login button
Priority: this user has been locked out.' is displayed

Title: Add product to cart and verify cart badge
Preconditions: User is logged in on inventory page
Steps: 1. Locate 'Sauce Labs Backpack'\n2. Click 'Add to cart' button\n3. Check shopping cart badge
Expected Result: Shopping cart badge count increments to 1

Title: Remove product from cart from inventory page
Preconditions: User has added 'Sauce Labs Backpack' to cart
Steps: 1. Click 'Remove' button on 'Sauce Labs Backpack'\n2. Check shopping cart badge
